item.name: Collect dishes
item.howToComplete: After a table finishes its meals, click the plates when Collect Dishes appears.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: Can be completed in another player's restaurant.
item.cardSummary: A repeating service objective. Clear finished plates after meals to fill the bar at the top of the screen.

item.name: Earn cash from tables
item.howToComplete: Collect the bill from a table after the group finishes its courses.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: Can be completed in another player's restaurant.
item.cardSummary: A service objective that counts bills taken from finished tables, not every Cash source in the restaurant.

item.name: Serve dishes
item.howToComplete: Take a finished dish from the Order Counter and serve it to the matching customer.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: Can be completed in another player's restaurant.
item.cardSummary: A service objective for handing cooked dishes to the matching customers from the Order Counter.

item.name: Cook dishes
item.howToComplete: Take an order from the Order Counter and finish the dish on kitchen appliances.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: Can be completed in another player's restaurant.
item.cardSummary: A cooking objective for finishing orders on kitchen appliances when the bar asks you to cook, not serve.

item.name: Earn cash
item.howToComplete: Earn Cash from restaurant play. Tips and food-critic pay count toward this objective.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: The auto-collect gamepass no longer blocks cash objectives.
item.cardSummary: A cash objective for making money from restaurant play. Tips and food-critic pay count, unlike the table-bill objective.

item.name: Spend cash on furniture
item.howToComplete: Spend Cash placing furniture in Build Mode.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: Sandbox mode does not assign this objective.
item.cardSummary: A building objective for spending Cash on furniture. Sandbox mode does not hand out this quest.

item.name: Buy furniture items
item.howToComplete: Buy furniture items in Build Mode.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: Counts furniture purchases rather than the Cash spent.
item.cardSummary: A building objective that counts how many furniture items you buy, not how much Cash you spend on them.

item.name: Seat customer groups
item.howToComplete: Seat arriving customer groups at tables.
item.reward: Can unlock a dish from 3 food options, or receive cash instead.
item.notes: Can be completed in another player's restaurant.
item.cardSummary: A service objective for seating arriving groups at tables so the dining room keeps moving.
